preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The length of the permutation n is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == n for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line contains exactly n integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= p <= n for p in line.split()) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the line is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(line.split())) == n for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each line contains n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: all(p[i] != i for p in output for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Each permutation is good, meaning no integer equals its index.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] < output[j] for i in range(n-1) for j in range(i+1, n))
postconditions.description: The output is lexicographically smallest among all good permutations.
